name: Уникни мату
description:
In this lesson the other, you are one move away from being checkmated. But you can still escape mate by using of the defense techniques that you have learned. It’s up to you to figure out how you can save yourself from being checkmated. 

What do you have to do?

Escape from being checkmated.

texts: Defend against the mate threat. Use the black king's position.
